policy: Separate fixed, time-limited root-only noisy CIFAR width study. Complete the five missing widths 8/16/32/64/128 at a common 1200-epoch budget, seed 409, same frozen CNN80 features, persistent training-noise map, splits and optimizer as the previous wide noisy study. Resume matching 400-epoch root tasks; reuse exact-task root checkpoints from the interrupted two-width tree follow-up when signatures match. No correction children are trained. Withhold test until all five fixed widths finish; do not stop, choose widths or change weights based on held-out metrics. Time cap is 38 minutes from startup with epoch checkpoints retained. Compare completed points to the matching root-only ablations at widths 256/512/1024. This is a root-width experiment, not a tree-depth experiment; one optimizer seed and reused test split are exploratory.
